summary: Verified Meta webhook DELIVERY LOGGING feature end-to-end. All 6 backend tests pass: invalid-sig→401+rejected log, valid-sig+bad leadgen→200+error log, admin auth enforced on webhook-log, response shape {count,logs[at,status,detail]} sorted newest-first, diagnose exposes recent_webhook_deliveries (<=10), and source_lead catalog still contains 'Meta Lead Ads'. Backend logs show no DuplicateKeyError on startup. app_secret (32 chars) read from db.settings.key=facebook to compute valid HMAC signature.
critical_code_review_comments: _log_webhook cap uses count+delete_many on every insert — fine at 200 threshold but O(count) per delivery once above cap. Consider a capped collection or periodic cleanup for very high volume.
In fb_webhook_log endpoint the sort is on 'at' (string) — works because now_utc_str() is ISO-8601 lexicographically sortable, but a note/index would harden this.
seed_data_creation: Test inserts 2 fb_webhook_log entries (1 rejected, 1 error) with leadgen_id='000000000000000_TEST_ITER17' — capped by the 200-entry limiter.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 17 verified fb webhook delivery logging (rejected/error/skipped/created outcomes) via /api/admin/facebook/webhook-log and 'recent_webhook_deliveries' in /api/admin/facebook/diagnose. app_secret lives in db.settings key='facebook'. Frontend rendering (Admin.jsx fb-webhook-deliveries) NOT tested — user asked backend only.
rca of the issue: Original silent failure: Meta was rejecting webhook deliveries due to app_secret mismatch causing 401 signature verification, but CRM logged nothing. New _log_webhook() helper persists every inbound outcome in db.fb_webhook_log (capped @200) — surfaced in both webhook-log and diagnose endpoints. Verified rejected (bad sig) and error (invalid Graph token/leadgen_id) paths write logs correctly.
